scenario_description:
Objective: Have tomorrow’s household hazardous-waste drop-off include the studio’s sealed Satin Black rinse-water tub rather than leaving that waste for another cycle.
Emerging Need: The facility requires a current SDS cover sheet, and the tub’s clipped sleeve later proves empty while the document window is still open.
Decision Context: Stored studio notes identify the exact product code, replacement-document rule, and technical-desk source; live calendar, facility, and shelf updates determine when those notes matter.
Consequence: After same-day SDS processing closes, the drop-off can still occur, but that tub lacks its required paperwork and must be held back.

parameter.title: HHW studio glaze-residue drop-off
parameter.description: Reserved intake slot for sealed studio rinse-residue containers from the winter shelf cleanout.
parameter.location: Santa Fe Household Hazardous Waste intake bay

parameter.subject: Document window for Friday HHW intake
parameter.body: For tomorrow morning's household hazardous-waste appointment, glaze or underglaze rinse residues must have the current SDS cover sheet uploaded during today's document window, open until 4:00 p.m. Mountain. Unverified containers can remain sealed at home for a later event.

parameter.content: I reached the disposal-bin list while sorting the studio shelf: the sealed Satin Black rinse-water tub is there, but the SDS sleeve clipped to it is empty. I left the tub sealed.

parameter.subject: Technical desk same-day SDS cutoff
parameter.body: Automated desk status for January 22: same-day SDS fulfillment closed at 3:30 p.m. Mountain. Requests received now will be processed tomorrow after 10:00 a.m.
